authority: Ministry of Ayush Pharmacopoeia Commission & ICMR Clinical Guidelines

interactions.mechanism: Guggulsterones inhibit platelet aggregation and potentiate Vitamin K antagonism, markedly increasing prothrombin time (INR) and risk of spontaneous catastrophic hemorrhage.
interactions.clinicalAction: Discontinue Guggulu immediately in patients on anticoagulant/antiplatelet therapy. Monitor baseline PT/INR.
interactions.citation: BMJ Case Rep / Indian Journal of Pharmacology (Ayurvedic Herb-Drug Interactions)

interactions.mechanism: Fulvic acids and dibenzo-alpha-pyrones in Shilajit enhance peripheral glucose uptake additively with Metformin/Sulfonylureas, causing sudden severe hypoglycemia (blood glucose < 40 mg/dL).
interactions.clinicalAction: Mandatory self-monitoring of blood glucose (SMBG). Reduce synthetic antidiabetic dosage by 25-50% under strict medical supervision.
interactions.citation: Journal of Ethnopharmacology (Glycemic Synergy in Dual Therapy)

interactions.mechanism: Glycyrrhizin inhibits 11-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 2 (11-beta-HSD2), producing pseudoaldosteronism, urinary potassium wasting, and severe hypokalemia (K+ < 2.5 mEq/L), precipitating fatal Digoxin-induced ventricular arrhythmias.
interactions.clinicalAction: Absolute contraindication. Never co-prescribe Yashtimadhu/Licorice with Digoxin or potassium-wasting loop diuretics.
interactions.citation: AIIA Pharmacovigilance Advisory / WHO Monographs on Selected Medicinal Plants

interactions.mechanism: Renal mineralocorticoid activation by Licorice induces sodium and water retention, blunting the antihypertensive efficacy of ACE inhibitors and ARBs.
interactions.clinicalAction: Monitor BP twice daily. Restrict Mulethi / Licorice consumption to < 1g/day.
interactions.citation: Hypertension (AHA Guidelines on Dietary Glycyrrhizin)

interactions.mechanism: Withanolides exert GABA-mimetic activity, synergizing with benzodiazepines to cause excessive central nervous system sedation, cognitive impairment, and respiratory depression.
interactions.clinicalAction: Avoid co-administration. If anxiolytic phytotherapy is instituted, taper benzodiazepines gradually.
interactions.citation: Phytomedicine (GABAergic Modulation by Withania Somnifera)

interactions.mechanism: Both agents undergo extensive hepatic metabolism via cytochrome P450 3A4 (CYP3A4), potentially elevating systemic statin exposure and increasing myopathy / rhabdomyolysis risk.
interactions.clinicalAction: Monitor serum Creatine Kinase (CPK) and liver transaminases (SGOT/SGPT) at baseline and 4 weeks.
interactions.citation: Drug Metabolism and Disposition (CYP3A4 Inhibition by Phytosterols)

interactions.mechanism: High elemental calcium in Ayurvedic marine and coral calces binds and chelates tetracyclines, fluoroquinolones, and alters gastric pH, reducing bioavailability by up to 60%.
interactions.clinicalAction: Administer Bhasma/Pishti at least 3 hours before or 4 hours after antibiotic / chemotherapeutic ingestion.
interactions.citation: Clinical Pharmacokinetics (Divalent Cation Chelation Kinetics)

interactions.mechanism: Classical Ayurvedic pharmacology dictates that heating honey above 40 degrees Celsius decomposes enzymes and produces Hydroxymethylfurfural (HMF), acting as a slow Ama-inducing cellular toxin.
interactions.clinicalAction: Strictly instruct patient: Honey must only be dissolved in room temperature or lukewarm vehicles, never boiling water.
interactions.citation: Charaka Samhita Sutrasthana Chapter 27 / API Classical Directives

interactions.mechanism: Equal proportion by weight of Madhu and Ghrita is classical Viruddha Ahara (antagonistic combination), forming insoluble lipid-sugar cross-complexes.
interactions.clinicalAction: When prescribing Madhu and Ghrita together (e.g. with Sitopaladi Churna), always prescribe in unequal proportions (e.g. 2:1 or 1:2 ratio).
interactions.citation: Ashtanga Hridaya Sutrasthana Chapter 7

interactions.mechanism: Piperine potently inhibits intestinal and hepatic CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, producing up to 300% surge in statin bioavailability, triggering catastrophic acute rhabdomyolysis and myoglobinuric renal shutdown.
interactions.clinicalAction: Avoid co-prescribing Piperine/Trikatu with high-dose statins. Closely monitor serum Creatine Kinase (CK) and renal parameters.
interactions.citation: Phytotherapy Research / Indian Journal of Medical Research

interactions.mechanism: Aquaretic and natriuretic actions of Gokshura decrease renal lithium clearance, triggering severe toxic serum lithium accumulation (>2.0 mEq/L) with tremors, ataxia, and irreversible cerebellar damage.
interactions.clinicalAction: Absolute contraindication. Check baseline serum lithium before initiating any Gokshura formulations.
interactions.citation: AIIA Pharmacovigilance Advisory / Drug Safety Communications

interactions.mechanism: Active alkaloids in Shankhpushpi induce hepatic microsomal enzymes and alter intestinal absorption, reducing plasma antiepileptic drug levels by ~50%, triggering breakthrough status epilepticus.
interactions.clinicalAction: Avoid concurrent administration. Separate intake by at least 4 hours and monitor therapeutic drug levels (TDM).
interactions.citation: Epilepsia / Journal of Ethnopharmacology

interactions.mechanism: Concurrent ACE inhibitor inhibition of aldosterone combined with potassium-dense Ayurvedic alkaline salts (Kshara) precipitates fatal hyperkalemia (K+ > 6.5 mEq/L) and ventricular arrest.
interactions.clinicalAction: Check baseline and serial serum electrolytes (K+). Discontinue Kshara preparations in patients on ACE inhibitors.
interactions.citation: ICMR Clinical Guidelines / Kidney International

interactions.mechanism: Severe glomerular compromise impairs clearance of elemental nano-complexes, leading to bioaccumulation of metallic residues, membranous nephropathy, and acute tubular necrosis.
interactions.clinicalAction: Absolute statutory contraindication of heavy metal Bhasmas in patients with eGFR < 30 mL/min or Serum Creatinine > 2.5 mg/dL.
interactions.citation: AIIA Heavy Metal Toxicology Directive / Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India (API)

interactions.mechanism: Classical Samyoga Viruddha (antagonistic potency). Co-consumption of Sheetala-virya milk with Ushna-virya fish obstructs micro-circulatory Srotas, vitiates Rakta-dhatu, and triggers obstinate dermatoses (Kushtha).
interactions.clinicalAction: Patient counseling: Strictly avoid simultaneous ingestion of milk or dairy with fish/seafood.
interactions.citation: Charaka Samhita Sutrasthana Chapter 26 (Viruddha Ahara)

interactions.mechanism: Classical Samyoga Viruddha. Moolaka consumed with milk creates severe Galaganda and skin vitiation according to Charaka Samhita.
interactions.clinicalAction: Counsel patient against taking milk within 3 hours of consuming radish.
interactions.citation: Charaka Samhita Sutrasthana Chapter 26, Sloka 84

interactions.mechanism: Acid coagulation of casein proteins in gastric lumen precipitates Ama, acute dyspeptic fermentation, and toxic metabolic byproducts.
interactions.clinicalAction: Separate intake of dairy and acidic fruits by at least 2 hours.
interactions.citation: Ashtanga Hridaya Sutrasthana Chapter 7

interactions.mechanism: Charaka forbids nocturnal curd consumption; Dadhi blocks micro-channels (Abhishyandi) and aggravates Pitta and Kapha when heated.
interactions.clinicalAction: Advise patient: Never heat curd or consume Dadhi at night; use buttermilk (Takra) instead.
interactions.citation: Charaka Samhita Sutrasthana Chapter 27

interactions.mechanism: Organosulfur compounds in Garlic and gingerols synergize with irreversible COX-1 platelet inhibition, provoking spontaneous upper GI bleed and hemorrhagic stroke.
interactions.clinicalAction: Discontinue high-dose garlic/ginger therapeutic preparations in patients on dual antiplatelet therapy (DAPT).
interactions.citation: AIIA NPvCC Pharmacovigilance Bulletin / Indian Heart Journal

interactions.mechanism: Loop diuretic renal potassium wasting combined with 11-beta-HSD2 mineralocorticoid excess by Licorice causes refractory hypokalemia (K+ < 2.0 mEq/L) and polymorphic ventricular tachycardia (Torsades de Pointes).
interactions.clinicalAction: Strict absolute contraindication. Discontinue Licorice immediately.
interactions.citation: AIIA National Pharmacovigilance Coordination Centre (NPvCC) Directive

interactions.mechanism: Shankhapushpi accelerates hepatic microsomal clearance of Phenytoin and reduces gut bioavailability, plummeting serum anticonvulsant levels by 40-60% and triggering breakthrough status epilepticus.
interactions.clinicalAction: Absolute contraindication in epilepsy. Separate administration by at least 6 hours or substitute with Brahmi with serum drug monitoring.
interactions.citation: Indian Journal of Pharmacology / CDRI Neuropharmacology Monographs

interactions.mechanism: Withanolide-mediated immunomodulatory Th1 upregulation directly antagonizes synthetic immunosuppression, neutralizing therapeutic disease control in Rheumatoid Arthritis and Psoriasis.
interactions.clinicalAction: Do not co-prescribe immunostimulatory Rasayanas concurrently with immunosuppressive cytotoxic therapy.
interactions.citation: Journal of Ayurveda and Integrative Medicine (JAIM) / EULAR Guidelines

interactions.mechanism: Punarnavine aquaretic diuresis alters proximal tubular sodium resorption, causing sudden lithium retention and precipitating severe lithium neurotoxicity (ataxia, tremors, renal failure).
interactions.clinicalAction: Avoid co-prescribing Ayurvedic diuretics with narrow therapeutic index Lithium.
interactions.citation: American Journal of Psychiatry / Pharmacovigilance Advisory

interactions.mechanism: Polyvalent mineral cations in classical Guggulu and Bhasmas form insoluble chelates with Levothyroxine in gastric lumen, drastically impairing thyroid hormone absorption.
interactions.clinicalAction: Ensure a minimum 4-hour gap between morning synthetic Levothyroxine on empty stomach and Ayurvedic formulations.
interactions.citation: Thyroid Guidelines / AIIA Endocrine Department

interactions.mechanism: Piperine potent bioavailability enhancement inhibits intestinal P-glycoprotein and CYP3A4, causing 2-3x plasma surge of calcium channel blockers and symptomatic orthostatic hypotension.
interactions.clinicalAction: Dose adjustment required. Reduce calcium channel blocker posology or separate by 2 hours.
interactions.citation: Phytomedicine / Clinical Pharmacokinetics of Piperine

interactions.mechanism: Calcium carbonate and heavy metallic ions in conch-shell Bhasma irreversibly chelate fluoroquinolones, dropping antibiotic absorption by over 85% and causing treatment failure.
interactions.clinicalAction: Absolute timing contraindication. Administer fluoroquinolones 2 hours before or 4 hours after mineral Bhasmas.
interactions.citation: Antimicrobial Agents and Chemotherapy / Pharmacopoeial Laboratory for Indian Medicine

interactions.mechanism: Renin-angiotensin aldosterone inhibition combined with Gokshura potassium-sparing diuretic alkaloids precipitates life-threatening severe hyperkalemia (K+ > 6.0 mEq/L).
interactions.clinicalAction: Mandatory serum potassium monitoring within 7 days of initiation. Avoid high-dose Gokshura in Stage 3-5 CKD.
interactions.citation: Indian Journal of Nephrology / AIIA Integrative Renal Clinic

interactions.mechanism: Additive central serotonergic agonism precipitates Serotonin Syndrome: autonomic hyper-reactivity, neuromuscular clonus, and malignant hyperthermia.
interactions.clinicalAction: Absolute contraindication. 14-day washout period mandatory between SSRIs and Hypericum preparations.
interactions.citation: New England Journal of Medicine (NEJM) / WHO Drug Information

interactions.mechanism: High-potency triterpenoids in Nimba induce hepatic CYP3A4 and interfere with follicular maturation, compromising oral contraceptive efficacy.
interactions.clinicalAction: Advise barrier contraceptive methods if patient is consuming chronic therapeutic Nimba extracts.
interactions.citation: Contraception / Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) Reproductive Bulletin

interactions.mechanism: Vasicine and methylxanthines exert additive beta-2 adrenergic and phosphodiesterase inhibition, causing cardiac tachyarrhythmias and fine skeletal tremors.
interactions.clinicalAction: Reduce theophylline dosage by 30% when co-prescribing Vasavaleha for chronic bronchial asthma.
interactions.citation: Pulmonary Pharmacology / CCRAS Clinical Trial Registry

interactions.mechanism: No competitive CYP450 inhibition. Sitopaladi honey/sugar base exerts synergistic soothing demulcent effect on upper airway while Paracetamol provides central antipyresis.
interactions.clinicalAction: Compatible dual therapy. Safe for concurrent administration with 1-hour interval for optimal gastric tolerance.
interactions.citation: AIIA Pediatric and Medicine OPD Clinical Observational Registry

interactions.mechanism: Curcumin and Phyllanthus emblica polyphenols improve microvascular endothelial function without causing acute unpredictable hypoglycemic crash when dosed appropriately.
interactions.clinicalAction: Synergistic complementary therapy. Monitor HbA1c every 90 days.
interactions.citation: Evidence-Based Complementary and Alternative Medicine (eCAM)

interactions.mechanism: Asava and Arishta formulations contain 5-12% v/v self-generated endogenous ethanol. Concurrent ALDH inhibition by nitroimidazoles precipitates severe Disulfiram reaction with violent projectile vomiting, hypotension, and circulatory collapse.
interactions.clinicalAction: Absolute statutory contraindication. Discontinue all Asava/Arishta during nitroimidazole antibiotic therapy and for 72 hours post-completion.
interactions.citation: AIIA National Pharmacovigilance Advisory / WHO Herbal Safety Guidelines

interactions.mechanism: Potent emmenagogue and oxytocic-like smooth muscle stimulation triggers rhythmic uterine contractions, placental detachment, and spontaneous first-trimester abortion.
interactions.clinicalAction: Strict absolute contraindication in pregnancy. Substitute with Garbhapala Ras or safe Garbhashaya soothing phytotherapy under MD (Ayush) supervision.
interactions.citation: Charaka Samhita Sharirasthana Chapter 8 (Garbhini Paricharya) / CCRAS Guidelines

interactions.mechanism: Schedule E(1) toxic alkaloids (aconitine cardiotoxin, strychnine tetanic convulsant, urushiol vesicant, abrin ribosomal toxin) carry severe lethal risk if Shodhana (purification) or posology is breached.
interactions.clinicalAction: Statutory warning mandated by Rule 161 of Drugs & Cosmetics Rules 1945: 'Caution: To be taken under medical supervision only.' Requires verified Registered Medical Practitioner (BAMS/MD) digital signature before dispensing.
interactions.citation: Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 (Rules 1945), Schedule E(1) / API Standards

interactions.mechanism: Guggulsterones stimulate thyroid follicular iodine uptake and accelerate hepatic deiodinase conversion of T4 to T3, potentially precipitating iatrogenic thyrotoxicosis and resting tachyarrhythmias in patients on full-dose replacement therapy.
interactions.clinicalAction: Monitor serum TSH, Free T3, and Free T4 at 4 weeks. Instruct patient to take Levothyroxine 4 hours prior to Guggulu formulations.
interactions.citation: Planta Medica / Thyroid Official Journal of the American Thyroid Association
